coordinate_transform_to_full_slide.mapping: full_x = source_x * scale_x; full_y = offset_y + source_y * scale_y

text_policy.logical_textbox_policy: one native textbox per authored block

connector_policy.ordinary_connector_route: native PowerPoint straight, elbow, curved, branch, merge, or shared-junction composition
connector_policy.routing_port_purpose: attach native connectors to measured junctions or normalized centerlines when preset shape connection sites are insufficient
connector_policy.custom_geometry_exception: only when the connector is itself a meaningful designed visual

icon_policy.canonical_asset_fit: explicit proportional contain geometry and center
icon_policy.slot_surface: remove when temporary, retain when part of final component design

style_configuration.whitespace: generous outside the information architecture and consistent within repeated components
style_configuration.visual_conventions: strong hierarchy, clean alignment, restrained fills, thin rules, explicit process relationships
style_configuration.diagram_conventions: clear directional flow, compact internal branches, purposeful connectors, no decorative legend
style_configuration.icon_treatment: simple Tabler-style outline pictograms in signature orange, proportionally contain-fitted and centered above a pale PwC warm-tint rectangular slot surface with consistent padding. Identity logos retain their canonical colors and are exempt from pictogram recoloring.

brand_inspiration.name: PwC-inspired consulting aesthetic
brand_inspiration.status: synthetic configurable approximation, not an official PwC brand standard
brand_inspiration.color_usage: Lead with white space and near-black typography. Use signature orange for hierarchy and directional emphasis. Use red, burgundy, yellow, warm tints, and warm neutrals selectively to distinguish information families without creating a rainbow palette.
brand_inspiration.shape_language: Use crisp rectangular color blocks, restrained cropped wedges or slanted momentum accents, thin warm-gray rules, and occasional stepped block relationships. Keep shape use purposeful and flat.
brand_inspiration.surface_language: Use white as the primary field, pale warm tint panels for secondary grouping, and saturated color blocks for small high-emphasis regions. Avoid decorative gradients and excessive rounded cards.

icon_slot_configuration.generation_rendering: Use a clear rectangular design container with a very light neutral or warm-tint surface. Keep its edges readable enough to establish the allocated region without drawing measurement guides or dashed annotations.
icon_slot_configuration.reconstruction_rendering: Remove the temporary slot surface when it is only placement scaffolding. Retain it when it is visibly part of the intended component design.

exact_source_content.title: Proposed Architecture for AI-Assisted Slide Drafting
exact_source_content.subtitle: High-quality editable slides can be produced by letting AI freely design within the right semantic and brand context, then systematically translating the generated visual back into clean, reusable PowerPoint objects.

stages.label: Communication & Semantic Planning
content: Determine content structure, relationships, hierarchy and emphasis
Produce layout-agnostic visual intent unless the user explicitly specifies layout

stages.label: Reference Retrieval
content: Style Rules (Configured typography, color system and visual conventions)

stages.label: Visual Generation
content: GPT Image 2 receives semantic visual intent, template references, selected assets and style rules
GPT Image 2 determines visual structure, use of supplied assets, creation of new visual elements and final composition

stages.label: Parallel Understanding of the Generated Image
content: Semantic Mapping (VLM) determines what each rendered element represents and maps known assets
Pixel-Level Measurement (OpenCV + SAM 2) measures positions, boundaries, colors, strokes and text-block geometry

stages.label: Editable PowerPoint Reconstruction
content: Known Element Reconstruction uses canonical assets, native PowerPoint objects and the Known Element Library
New / Redesigned Element Reconstruction uses semantic decomposition, standard PowerPoint shapes and connectors, geometry fitting, and raster only when required

fit_policy.text: Measured outer geometry is immutable. Font metrics, line spacing, paragraph spacing, and insets are fitted inside it.
fit_policy.line_art: OpenCV masks are skeletonized and decomposed into lines, ellipses, rectangles, and residual custom paths.
fit_policy.sam: SAM remains reserved for irregular filled regions and is disabled for thin line art.

refinement_pass.policy: Bounded semantic-system normalization after initial reconstruction fit.

constrained_normalization.policy: Semantic peer normalization with hard containment, clearance, movement, and rollback constraints.

decisions.semantic_basis: The two objects are peer technology attribution badges placed at the bottom of adjacent stage containers.
